g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: Power - protected input, 4.30 V, 3.3 V

g.desc: Title: Power - protected input, 4.30 V, 3.3 V

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: J1 pin 1 = +DC; pin 2 = GND. F2: T3.15A. Q1 reverse polarity; D1 clamps |VGS|.

g.desc: J1 pin 1 = +DC; pin 2 = GND. F2: T3.15A. Q1 reverse polarity; D1 clamps |VGS|.

g.text: D2 SMBJ16A: 16 V standoff, 26 V rated pulse clamp. Not a sustained overvoltage regulator.

g.desc: D2 SMBJ16A: 16 V standoff, 26 V rated pulse clamp. Not a sustained overvoltage regulator.

g.text: C47 input bulk; C35/C36 are local amplifier bulk. Use a regulated, current-limited SELV supply.

g.desc: C47 input bulk; C35/C36 are local amplifier bulk. Use a regulated, current-limited SELV supply.

g.text: R27/R28: PVDD/11 -> GPIO36; 100n filtering. ADC1 works while Wi-Fi is active.

g.desc: R27/R28: PVDD/11 -> GPIO36; 100n filtering. ADC1 works while Wi-Fi is active.

g.text: TLV1117LV33: 1 A; tab = output. Retained topology, reduced input voltage.

g.desc: TLV1117LV33: 1 A; tab = output. Retained topology, reduced input voltage.

g.text: Use copper heat spreading. C52 10u ceramic plus C55 22u at ESP32.

g.desc: Use copper heat spreading. C52 10u ceramic plus C55 22u at ESP32.

g.text: TPS7A2033 on DAC sheet supplies only the DAC.

g.desc: TPS7A2033 on DAC sheet supplies only the DAC.

g.text: U3 retained: 3 A, 500 kHz forced PWM. 0.6 x (1 + 100k/16k2) = 4.304 V.

g.desc: U3 retained: 3 A, 500 kHz forced PWM. 0.6 x (1 + 100k/16k2) = 4.304 V.

g.text: L1 6u8: ripple ~0.93 A p-p at 16 V, nominal 500 kHz. Local ceramics at VIN/SW.

g.desc: L1 6u8: ripple ~0.93 A p-p at 16 V, nominal 500 kHz. Local ceramics at VIN/SW.

g.text: C45 10u / 50V X5R: ~3u typical at 16V; estimated VIN ripple ~0.13Vpp at 1A output.

g.desc: C45 10u / 50V X5R: ~3u typical at 16V; estimated VIN ripple ~0.13Vpp at 1A output.

g.text: Feeds both 3.3 V LDOs. Do not substitute the PFM LMR51430X version.

g.desc: Feeds both 3.3 V LDOs. Do not substitute the PFM LMR51430X version.

g.text: VIN_SENSE is advisory: mute/shut down early during a falling input; verify hold-up on bench.

g.desc: VIN_SENSE is advisory: mute/shut down early during a falling input; verify hold-up on bench.
